International Student Scholarship – Postgraduate £5,000
The International Postgraduate Student Scholarship is available to all new International students joining for a taught programme at the University* in 2026/27. This is an automatic scholarship that will be applied to your offer letter

International Student Scholarship – Undergraduate £4,000
The International Undergraduate Student Scholarship is available to all new International students joining for a taught programme at the University* in 2026/27. This is an automatic scholarship that will be applied to your offer letter.
